description:
【愿景】
美团搜索服务日均处理数亿次查询,我们正在经历从“统计匹配”向“认知推理”的 Search 3.0 跨越。你将不仅是算法的优化者,更是搜索基座和业务应用的构建者(Builder)。通过构建高泛化、可扩展的算法基座,支撑医药、闪购等多元业务线的智能化升级,定义下一代生活服务搜索的本质规律。
【你将参与】
你将直接优化影响数亿用户的核心搜索链路,用大模型技术解决搜索的关键瓶颈。
1.意图理解基座:超越传统的分类与匹配,利用 LLM 构建具备认知能力的意图基座,深度解构口语化、省略表达及多意图混合等复杂场景。探索 Query 的语义改写、扩展与纠错技术,将非结构的“人话”精准转化为结构化的搜索逻辑,实现对用户深层需求的本质洞察。
2.排序预估基座:推动排序模型的 Scaling Up,探索大参数量模型在 Relevance 判断与 Ranking 中的性能边界,提升对复杂 Query-POI 关系的建模深度。负责 LLM-based Reranking、特征增强及神经符号 AI 的结合,利用 Scaling Law 提升排序逻辑的泛化性与预估精度。
3.生成式召回基座:构建基于大模型的语义表示学习体系,突破长尾 Query 与 POI 的匹配瓶颈。优化向量召回与混合召回策略,在海量候选集中精准平衡相关性、多样性与发现感,实现“所想即所得”。
4.引导增长基座: 研发下一代搜索引导与推荐算法,通过生成式技术优化搜索前/中的用户路径,提升用户发现价值的效率。探索搜索与推荐的深度融合,利用 AI Agent 能力引导用户决策,实现业务增长与用户体验的协同进化。
5.跨业务 Builder 型组织建设:作为 Builder,构建跨业务(餐饮、医药、即时零售、服务零售、酒旅等)的通用算法框架,确保技术底座能够快速适配不同垂直场景的特性。在毫秒级延迟的严苛约束下,主导大模型在线 Serving 优化,通过蒸馏、量化、缓存等手段实现效果与性能的极致平衡。

description:
Business Unit
Cloud & Smart Industries Group (CSIG) is responsible for promoting the company's cloud and industry Internet strategy. CSIG explores the interactions between users and industries to create innovative solutions for smart industries via technological advancements such as cloud, AI, and network security. While driving the digitalization of retail, medical, education, transportation and other industries, CSIG helps companies serve users in smarter ways, building a new ecosystem of intelligent industries that connect users and businesses.
What the Role Entails
As a Senior Solution Architect at Tencent Cloud in Thailand, you will play a pivotal role in driving the adoption and success of Tencent Cloud services in the region. This position requires a blend of technical acumen, customer-facing skills, and strategic thinking. You will work closely with clients and partners to understand their needs, develop tailored cloud solutions, and ensure successful implementation. Your expertise will contribute to shaping Tencent Cloud’s product offerings and go-to-market strategies, making a significant impact on the business landscape in Thailand.
What You Can Do Here
1. Accelerate your growth with an international perspective, engage with top-tier Southeast Asia customers, and deeply participate in the most cutting-edge AI needs of the Southeast Asia market and the continuously evolving cloud industry solutions.
2. Master the latest cloud product capabilities in a full-stack manner — across IaaS, AI, audio/video, security and other product lines. Through project co-building with Southeast Asia customers, continuously improve human-AI collaboration capability and customer project success efficiency.
3. Work closely with a diverse, excellent team in Southeast Asia, and jointly embark on a rapidly changing high-growth journey.Serve as the customer's technical consulting expert. Lead Tencent Cloud pre-sales analysis, bidding document authoring, and customer solution communication, and strive to obtain support from the customer's technical decision-making level.
Deeply explore and follow up on the landing of customer needs. Combined with Tencent Cloud public cloud, private cloud, container, big data, audio/video, AI and other product capabilities, design technical solutions for Thailand SVIP customers and follow up on delivery, continuously strengthening differentiated competitive advantages.
Possess an AI-Native perspective, be proficient in Tencent Cloud AI product knowledge and effectively promote it. Use AI capabilities to complete project POCs and demos, accelerate migration and delivery, and monitor SVIP customer business quality.
Promote scaled business growth in key markets. On a daily basis, collect real feedback and industry common needs from Thailand customers, and drive continuous iteration and optimization of cloud products and AI tools.
Who We Look For
Bachelor's degree or above; majors in computer science, information technology, telecommunications engineering and other related fields are preferred.
5+ years of experience in cloud computing pre-sales or solution-related work, covering pre-sales research, bidding document authoring, POC implementation, delivery acceptance, and other project phases.
Familiar with mainstream public cloud platforms, such as Tencent Cloud, Alibaba Cloud, AWS, Azure, GCP, etc. Have experience using AI technology to assist and drive projects; familiar with at least one AI Agent application and have effectively applied it in work.
Extremely strong pressure resistance and resilience. Proactively tackle project technical risks and AI implementation challenges, with no shirking or escaping. Take real business results as the sole orientation, and refuse to stay only at paper-level solutions.
Excellent cross-cultural communication and collaboration ability; fluent English with no barriers to business communication; adapt to the collaboration rhythm of multi-country teams. Thai language proficiency is preferred.
Strong proactive collaboration awareness; willing to undertake cross-department collaborative work, with no division of work boundaries, and project success as the core goal.
Equal Employment Opportunity at Tencent
As an equal opportunity employer, we firmly believe that diverse voices fuel our innovation and allow us to better serve our users and the community. We foster an environment where every employee of Tencent feels supported and inspired to achieve individual and common goals.
Work Location: Thailand-Bangkok

工作内容:
1. 研发多模态大模型(MLLM),提升模型对图像/视频内容的深度语义理解、描述(Captioning)及问答能力。
2. 负责基于 Qwen-image-edit / Flux等架构的图像生成算法优化,提升生成质量、多样性和可控性。研发针对特定风格、人物或场景的 包括但不限于LoRA / ControlNet / IP-Adapter 等微调与控制技术。探索图像高清化(Upscaling)、局部重绘(Inpainting)及属性编辑等落地场景。
3. 负责文生视频(T2V)、图生视频(I2V)前沿算法的跟踪与实现(如 Sora,, Veo-3 类似架构)。优化视频生成的时空一致性、动作流畅度及长视频生成能力,探索视频风格迁移、数字人驱动及视频编辑相关技术。
T-Star实习可以带给你什么?

requirement:
